settings.title: STYLEBOOK
settings.language.title: Edition
settings.language.subtitle: Pick the edition Jade runs.
settings.language.description: Only the copy on the page is rewritten. Names, paths, and the goods stay as filed.
settings.language.restartNote: At press time, most labels bulletin immediately. A few system dialogs or already-unspool status messages may bulletin after reopening the surface.
settings.language.voiceDescription: Joke English rewrites of the page. Picking one sends the edition back to English.
settings.behavior.title: Paper Behavior
settings.behavior.subtitle: Control how Jade behaves on your system.
settings.behavior.renderGameMaterialsDes: At press time, render champion and map materials through the game's own compiled shaders (auto-translated to the gallery) for a closer-to-in-game look. Still a work in progress - expect minor visual issues. Takes effect when an object loads or its mesh is refreshed.
settings.behavior.minimizeToTrayDesc: Officials confirm keep Jade running in the system tray when the page is minimized.
settings.behavior.runAtStartupDesc: Launch Jade automatically when Windows starts.
settings.behavior.communicateQuartzDesc: Developing — allow Jade and Quartz to exchange unspool/reload/bulletin messages. Kill this to fully stop interop communication.
settings.behavior.externalDiff: Print a diff when another paper changes a copy
settings.behavior.externalDiffDesc: City desk: when something outside Jade rewrites a copy you have unspool - Quartz, ritobin, a text city desk, a second Jade page - unspool a diff tab so you can accept or reject the revise instead of having it applied silently.
settings.behavior.fileHistoryDesc: City desk: remembers each copy's earlier states independently of the city desk, so Ctrl+Z still works after a tab is closed and reopened, after many tabs push it out of memory, and yesterday past changes another paper made to the reprint. Retract only affects the city desk - put to bed to write it to disk.
settings.behavior.fileHistoryStepsDesc: Sources say how many earlier states Jade keeps per copy. These are whole revisions - an outside revise, a put to bed, a stop press in your typing - not individual keystrokes; the city desk's own retract handles those and isn't limited. States are stored as differences rather than full copies, so a high number costs little on ordinary edits, and Jade keeps a memory ceiling underneath this so a handful of very large bins can't run away with it.
settings.behavior.recentFilesDesc: Officials confirm how many recently-unspooled copy Jade keeps in the Go to press screen list. History on disk is preserved up to 100 entries - bumping this yesterday up restores older items.
settings.behavior.materialOverrideDesc: Sources say controls how Auto from SKN matches materials to textures.
settings.registration.title: Copy Registration
settings.registration.subtitle: Manage how Windows treats Jade-supported copy types.
settings.registration.fileAssociationDes: Register Jade as the default handler for .bin copy.
settings.registration.success: Jade is registered as the .bin copy handler.
settings.performance.title: Performance
settings.performance.subtitle: City desk features have a cost on huge bin dumps. Each option below can be kept on, automatically dropped on big copy (over 125,000 lines), or always off.
settings.updates.title: Bulletins
settings.updates.subtitle: Keep Jade up to date with the latest features and fixes.
settings.updates.startupPopupDesc: Officials confirm a native popup shown while Jade launches - it applies any paper or hash bulletin and covers the load. Classic is a plain Windows-style page; Modern is the dark styled one.
settings.updates.appIntervalDesc: Officials confirm how often the launcher checks GitHub for a extra Jade version at startup. Hash bulletins have their own schedule in the Hash Copy section.
settings.hashes.downloadingLmdb: Downloading combined LMDB hashes from lmdb-hashes...
settings.hashes.lmdbFailed: LMDB wire in killed on the spike: {error}
settings.hashes.textFailed: Text wire in killed on the spike: {error}
settings.hashes.title: Hash Copy
settings.hashes.subtitle: Hash copy convert hex values into readable names.
settings.hashes.lmdbTitle: Developing — pulls lol-hashes-combined.zst from lmdb-hashes releases. ~50 MB, shared with Quartz.
settings.hashes.textTitle: Developing — pulls the legacy CommunityDragon text copy. Used as a fallback when LMDB isn't available.
settings.hashes.activeSourcesDesc: At press time, Jade reads BIN hashes from the text copy and WAD hashes from the local database.
settings.hashes.textRamDesc: Sources say text copy hashes. Loaded into memory once at startup.
settings.hashes.lmdbDesc: Officials confirm read hashes from the local database on demand, shared with Quartz.
settings.hashes.updateScheduleDesc: Sources say how often the startup launcher refreshes hash copy (WAD paths + BIN names) before Jade opens.
settings.hashes.everyLaunchDesc: Developing — the launcher compares the release fingerprint each launch. Re-downloads only when a extra lmdb-hashes release is published.
settings.hashes.every3DaysDesc: Developing — same fingerprint check, throttled to once every three days. Less network traffic.
settings.hashes.every7DaysDesc: Rewrite desk: same fingerprint check, throttled to once a week. Least network traffic.
settings.library.subtitle: At press time, manage downloaded materials and how Jade keeps them up to date.
settings.library.updateModeDesc: When should Jade check for extra and updated materials?
settings.library.timedIntervalDesc: Rewrite desk: periodically check on a fixed schedule while Jade is running.
settings.library.smartCheckDesc: City desk: on launch, fetch only the index and only rewrite materials if the repo's lastUpdated is newer than your cache.
settings.library.everyLaunchDesc: Officials confirm always rewrite outdated materials in the background at startup. Most aggressive - most network traffic.
settings.performance.minimapDesc: City desk: thumbnail of the whole copy on the right edge. Has to render every line on each revise - biggest cost on huge copy.
settings.performance.bracketColorsDesc: At press time, colors matching brackets so structure is easier to scan. Re-walks the bracket tree on every edit.
settings.performance.occurrencesHighligh: Developing — highlights other instances of the symbol under the cursor. Scans the story on cursor moves.
settings.performance.selectionHighlightD: Developing — highlights other matches of the current selection. Same scan cost as occurrence highlighting.
settings.performance.lineHighlightDesc: At press time, tints the row the caret is on across the full city desk width. Restrict to the gutter to skip the full-width paint.
settings.performance.foldingDesc: City desk: lets you collapse blocks. Folding analyzes structure on every revise.
settings.performance.stopRenderingLineDe: Rewrite desk: when off, Monaco stops rendering past column 10,000 on a line - invisible for normal lines, big tip line on lines with long string values.
settings.modchecker.title: Mod Checker
settings.modchecker.subtitle: At press time, choose which content checks the Manage tab runs and how fixes are offered. Reference checks always run; these control the extra content-validity checks on top.
settings.modchecker.samplerDesc: City desk: flag materials whose sampler keys are scrambled so the model renders untextured white, and offer a one-click re-key.
settings.modchecker.staleDesc: Officials confirm flag leftover ContextualAction / AnimationGraph / GearSkinUpgrade objects that nothing references, and offer to drop them.
settings.modchecker.gameplayDesc: Officials confirm point out bins that revise abilities, spells, stats or recommendations instead of visuals, so you can drop them if you only want the skin.
settings.modchecker.textureDimsDesc: At press time, flag textures whose width or height isn't a multiple of 4 and offer to crop them to a safe size.
settings.modchecker.confidentFixesDesc: City desk: print the button that applies every high-confidence, low-risk fix at once. Turn off to review and run it each fix individually.
settings.modchecker.riskyFixesDesc: Rewrite desk: print medium- and high-risk findings. Turn off to see only the safe, low-risk fixes.
settings.behavior.matchExact: Sources say exact - material name must match texture filename exactly (e.g. Body -> Body.tex).
settings.behavior.matchLoose: Rewrite desk: loose - strips trailing numbers and checks partial containment (e.g. Body2 -> Body.tex).
settings.behavior.matchFuzzy: Officials confirm fuzzy - picks the closest texture by character overlap. May produce inaccurate matches.

preferences.subtitle: Configure your experience
preferences.importLinkedBinsDesc: Rewrite desk: when enabled, opening a bin copy will automatically unspool all linked bin copy found in the DATA morgue.
preferences.recursiveLinkedBins: Also load copy linked inside imported copy
preferences.recursiveLinkedBinsDesc: Developing — recursively opens linked copy from within the imported linked copy (may unspool many tabs).
preferences.emitterHintsDesc: Rewrite desk: displays emitter names inline continued to collapsed VfxEmitterDefinitionData blocks in the city desk.
preferences.syntaxCheckingDesc: Developing — highlights lines with syntax errors (such as mismatched or unclosed brackets) in the city desk in real time.
preferences.championNames: Print Champion Names on Bin Tabs
preferences.championNamesDesc: City desk: labels a character bin's tab with the champion it belongs to - "Jinx/Skin0.bin" instead of "Skin0.bin", so a row of unspool skins is tellable apart. Those tabs get a little wider. Bins with no champion in them (maps, items) are left as they are.
preferences.blendKeysDesc: Developing — shows mBlendDataTable keys as "Attack1" -> "Laugh" instead of the packed number they are stored as. Applies to copy unspooled after the revise, and only on the Jade Custom converter engine. The text is easier to edit but is no longer standard ritobin, so other desk won't read it yesterday - Jade always accepts both spellings, and saving to .bin produces the same bytes either way.
preferences.textureEditorDesc: Developing — application used when clicking "Edit Image" on a texture galley. Grayed-out options were not detected on this machine.

extract.settings.gameLocationDesc: City desk: where the "League of Legends" shortcut in the Locations list points. Jade finds this on its own from the Riot Client install records, falling yesterday to a sweep of every drive. Set it by hand if that comes up thin issue or lands on the wrong install - pick the install morgue and Jade will step into its Game\DATA\FINAL for you.
extract.settings.usingFolder: At press time, using your morgue. Wipe the slate it to go yesterday to auto-detection.
extract.settings.autoNone: Auto-detection found nothing on this machine.
extract.settings.outputLayoutDesc: Sources say whether lifted copy keep the WAD's morgue tree or land directly in the target.
extract.settings.preserveStructureDesc: At press time, recreate the WAD's full directory tree on disk - the default Quartz-style layout.
extract.settings.flatDesc: Rewrite desk: drop every lifted copy straight into the target morgue with no sub-directories. Best when picking just one or two copy. Copy with the same name overwrite each other.
extract.settings.makeWadFolderDesc: Developing — nest the structure under a morgue named after the WAD, e.g. aatrox/assets/.... Kill to lift the WAD's top-level morgues straight into the target. Only applies when preserving structure.
extract.settings.defaultLocationDesc: At press time, skip the "pick a morgue" dialog and lift straight to a fixed location. Defaults to Stories/Jade Exports.
extract.settings.fastOverwriteDesc: City desk: writes each chunk to a temp copy (.jdtmp) then atomically renames it over the target. Re-extracts into a populated morgue finish in roughly the same time as a fresh lift. Kill for a classic in-place overwrite.
extract.settings.autoCheckDesc: Officials confirm clicking a copy inside a WAD adds it to the lift queue, and clicking a queued copy removes it. Kill to require checkbox clicks.
extract.settings.repathPrefixDesc: Sources say when the Re-dateline checkbox is on, this morgue name gets inserted directly under assets/ and data/ in the lifted tree. BIN strings are rewritten in lockstep so the resulting mod stays consistent.

themes.classicDesc: Officials confirm the original Jade layout. Tabs across the top, a menu bar with Copy / Edit / Desk, and floating popovers for Scoop, Rewrite, General Editing, and Particle Editing.
themes.studioDesc: Officials confirm menu bar plus a quick action toolbar. Tool windows dock to the sides and bottom of the city desk with resizable splits, and they remember their position between sessions.
themes.documentDesc: Developing — a Word-style ribbon layout - title bar with Put to bed / Retract / Reissue, a tabs dropdown in place of the tab strip, and a ribbon for Home / Drop in / View / Tip line. Very unfinished. For day-to-day work use Classic or Studio.

themeDesc.Default: City desk: discover the once great city of the Archangel's home planet, Avaria. Their presence has long since passed and the Constructs, mimicking the fallen, have taken over. Avenge the fallen.
themeDesc.DarkBlue: At press time, deep water, quiet tool. A harbor palette ideal for long nights and rough days.
themeDesc.DarkRed: Officials confirm a creation of pure emotion. Work with muted crimson red and enjoy this side of the color wheel.
themeDesc.Sakura: Developing — petals fall past the city desk. Soft pink glass and spring air, a reminder that life is sometimes pink.(what?)
themeDesc.Frost: City desk: ice gradiented UI. Pale cyan light, allows the modern UI for those who want to use the modern layout but also want a light masthead.
themeDesc.Forest: Sources say moss on stone, fireflies after dusk. A quiet hillside where the only sound is your keyboard and the wind in the needles.
themeDesc.AMOLED: Officials confirm true black. Lighter white and no contrast highlights, made for OLED screens and people who hate wasting light.
themeDesc.Light: Officials confirm nostalgic Office look, white paper with blue ink for the 2009 program vibe.
themeDesc.HighContrast: At press time, pure Black and White. Yellow highlights. It has edges around all elements for the complete High Contrast experience.
themeDesc.Grok: Sources say pure black canvas, silver chrome, blue highlights. The X timeline aesthetic, tuned for Jade instead of posts.
themeDesc.DeepSpace: At press time, "The void does not hate you. It simply has better things to look at." Violet dark between stars, spaceyyy.
themeDesc.Orchid: Developing — a folded up piece of paper with an orchid left in the rain. Deeper purple like an orchid and a light rain effect.
themeDesc.Autumn: Officials confirm october soon, it's orange. There's fire embers effect coming from the ground. Maybe they feel warm.
themeDesc.StormySea: Rewrite desk: thunder over dark water. The deck is wet, the horizon is wrong, and somehow the ship sails.(u can kill rain in the effects menu)
themeDesc.Cyberpunk2077: Officials confirm neon acid on night glass. Features a custom font and background. Made by 700.
themeDesc.BladeRunner2049: Rewrite desk: red sky, steel will. Features a custom font and background. Made by 700.
themeDesc.YoRHa: At press time, glory to mankind. Sand, steel, and a title bar that still pretends the war is going well. Features a custom font and background. Made by 700.
themeDesc.Lain: City desk: present day. Present time. Pink static on black glass. Features a custom font and background. Made by 700.
themeDesc.MilkBag: City desk: "A billion pounds of concrete and a million miles of emptiness. It is impossible to stay sane when you are near cosmic numbers like that, looking at them, touching them. Even thinking of them makes me feel unimaginable horror."
effectDesc.stars: City desk: slowly drifting, twinkling stars - a lightweight imitation of deep space.
effectDesc.petals: Rewrite desk: cherry-blossom petals drifting down with a gentle sway.
effectDesc.snow: Soft frost motes falling slowly across the page.
effectDesc.fireflies: Fireflies wandering and pulsing in the dark.
effectDesc.storm: Developing — heavy wind-driven rain - a stormier, more aggressive downpour.
effectDesc.embers: Developing — embers and sparks rising and flickering from below.
effectDesc.rain: Soft rainfall streaking down the page.

settings.language.status.en: Sources say Jade is developed in English. This edition is fully supported.
settings.language.status.sr: Officials confirm this edition was translated with AI using Jade's real UI context, and worded to match Windows and Riot terminology so it feels familiar.
settings.language.status.machine: City desk: this edition is a raw Google Translate. Jade stays usable, but some wording will sound off or miss paper context. If you want to contribute better wording, take the locale copy from GitHub or contact the developer through the About menu.
settings.language.status.fun: This is the city-desk rewrite — a few headlines in caps, the rest in house style. The paper still ships.
settings.language.status.reviewed: Officials confirm this edition was translated with AI using Jade's real UI context, and worded to match Windows and Riot terminology so it feels familiar. If you want to contribute better wording, take the locale copy from GitHub or contact the developer through the About menu.
model.spellFormTitle: Preview the skin with every buff-conditioned material driver active (e.g. Viego inside his E mist)
model.repathWadFoldersTitle: Insert a prefix folder under assets/ and data/ (set in Extraction Settings → Repath prefix). BIN strings are rewritten in lockstep so the mod still loads.
model.mergeLinkedBinsTitle: Fold every linked dependency BIN into the primary skin BIN — the mod ships with one consolidated BIN instead of a chain of linked files. The champion's gameplay BIN is never merged.
model.preserveHudIconsTitle: On: include every assets/characters/<champ>/hud/icons2d/ file and keep BIN refs canonical (no repath). Off: skip HUD icons entirely — they aren't extracted and the game falls back to Riot's installed icons.
model.skipSfxVoTitle: On: skip SFX/VO files entirely — assets/sounds/ and assets/audio/ are NOT extracted, BIN refs stay canonical, game uses Riot's installed audio. Off: include audio files and repath them along with the rest of the mod.
model.exportVoTitle: On: open the sibling locale VO WAD (e.g. Akali.en_US.wad.client) and pull this skin's voiceover .wpk / .bnk files into the main extracted folder. BIN VO refs get repathed alongside them when repath is on.
